data.title: Al Habtoor Tower
data.about:
Prepare to be awestruck by the most anticipated addition to Dubai’s iconic skyline! Welcome to Al Habtoor Tower, a testament to redefined opulence that will leave you breathless. Standing tall at an impressive 82 stories, this architectural marvel by the prestigious Al Habtoor Group sets the standard for beauty, quality, and uncompromising service. 

Indulge in the epitome of luxury as you step into the world within this extraordinary tower. Immerse yourself in the sheer elegance and cutting-edge technology found in our meticulously designed 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments. Every inch showcases the finest materials and the latest in smart home innovation.

Ascend to the height of grandeur as you discover the crown jewel of the tower – the luxurious residences. Experience the ultimate in exclusivity with private pools and balconies that unveil mesmerizing panoramas of the city, desert, and Arabian Gulf. This residential marvel stands unparalleled, a true masterpiece that redefines Dubai’s architectural landscape. Don’t let this extraordinary opportunity slip away. Claim your place in Al Habtoor Tower and embrace a lifestyle of unparalleled beauty, comfort, and sophistication. Seize the moment and embark on a journey of unrivaled luxury living. Your dreams await at Al Habtoor Tower. Act now and elevate your lifestyle to extraordinary heights.

characteristics_module.title: A residential masterpiece, step into luxury
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Landmark tower inspiring canal views
  • Exclusive location on Shiekh Zayed Road
  • 82 stories of exquisite, spacious apartments
  • 3 dedicated floors for amenities
  • Offering ownership on Sheikh Zayed Road
  • Smart and Sustainable living
  • Starting price AED 2.1M
  • 27 restaurants, Hotels, Tennis Academy
  • Located in the well established community of Al Habtoor City
  • A variety of residences including sky villas with private pool

location_tile.title: Find out why Al Habtoor Tower in famous Al Habtoor City along Dubai’s most beautiful canal has an unrivalled charm
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
This famous landmark, about to be completed by Al Habtoor Group, is the very definition of beauty, excellence, and unmatched service. The nearby Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) provides unrivalled connectivity to the rest of Dubai, including the city centre, the beach, and beyond. Experience the height of luxury at the most sought-after address; you won’t find a greater place to call home anywhere else.

  • 10 mins to Downtown Dubai
  • 10 mins to Dubai Opera
  • 10 mins to City Walk
  • 10 mins to DIFC
